integrity: Analytic derivation is supplied; an ordinary standalone symbolic/numerical checker supports reproducibility but not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Requires stationary symmetric two-state trap switching, positive unequal trap rates, independent additive Brownian drivers. No asymmetric switching, nonlinear, interaction, or finite-sample theorem. Literature priority is subject to independent review.
title: A harmonic-mean spectral collision in collective correlations of a switching harmonic trap
